name: web-audio-show-creation-modal-with-dropzone-selectors-and-black-generate-button
title: White modal 'Create Your Audio Show' with an upload tab bar, dashed dropzone, format and voice selectors and a black Generate button
whatItIs: A white card with a dark round icon, a bold title and description, a three-tab bar (Upload File, Import via URL, Choose Existing), a dashed dropzone with an upload icon and Browse Files button, a Format Style select, paired Host and Guest voice selects, Voice Engine and Language selects, an Audio Quality select and a footer with a Recent dropdown and a black Generate button.
whatItMeans: Structured and approachable; grouped fields and one black action make a complex form feel simple.
techniques: Frame upload as a dashed dropzone.
Pair related selects in two columns.
End with one black primary button.

vocabulary.definition: A dashed area for dropping files.
A dropdown input with a value.
Tabs choosing how to provide content.
A black button for the main action.
